card.fires_on: The word "form" right after "in the" when it starts the phrase "in the form of", meaning in the shape or state of something. It also fires on small words just before "form" in similar phrases.

modes.label: in the form of
modes.description: The word "form" in the phrase "in the form of", introducing the shape or type something takes.
modes.example: Pastel is an Art medium in the<< form>> of a stick consisting of pure powdered Pig

modes.description: A linking word just before an expected "form", as in "forms of" or "in their natural form".

card.writes: It lowers the chance that the next word is "form" or its variants, since "form" has just appeared or is about to.
card.plain: It marks the phrase "in the form of", where something is described by the shape or type it takes.
